remarks: Ground level, corner unit. Very open floor plan in this 2 bedroom unit with two bathrooms. Wood floors throughout , remodeled kitchen and open to family room and dinning room areas. Beautiful countertops and a spacious eating bar in between the kitchen and living space. There are plantation shutters throughout the living and dining rooms, recessed lighting and great storage throughout. There is a spacious master bedroom with a walking in closet that includes professional closet organizers/drawers. 2nd bedroom closet is custom. Both bedrooms have ceiling fan. Other upgrades include forced air heating and double pane windows (except in front). There is one car garage that is assigned to this
